sub>0</sub> / 范围</strong></div>
</div></div>
<div class="card"><div class="formula-kicker">Core Formula</div><div class="formula">起振检查：|AF| ≥ 1</div><div class="formula">文氏桥：f<sub>0</sub> = 1 / (2πRC)</div><div class="formula">三点式相位判断：射同基反</div><div class="note">振荡题先做“点检”，再算公式：有没有放大环节？有没有正反馈？有没有选频网络？RC 文氏桥偏低频，LC 三点式偏高频，石英晶体用于高稳定、固定频率附近的选频。原图再复杂，也先重画交流通路。</div></div>
</section>
<section class="section"><div class="section-head"><h2>速通</h2></div><div class="quick-grid">
<div class="quick"><div class="n">01 · 基本条件</div><h3>不是“有反馈”就能振</h3><p>先查放大、正反馈、选频；再分起振条件与平衡条件。</p></div>
<div class="quick"><div class="n">02 · RC</div><h3>文氏桥是主线</h3><p>文氏桥：F 常取 1/3；频率由 RC 决定。</p></div>
<div class="quick"><div class="n">03 · LC</div><h3>三点式先用“射同基反”</h3><p>三点式先用“射同基反”判相位。</p></div>
<div class="quick"><div class="n">04 · 谐振网络</div><h3>并联与串联别混</h3><p>并联 LC：低频感、高频容；串联 LC 相反。</p></div>
<div class="quick"><div class="n">05 · 共集</div><h3>看到 CC 要警惕</h3><p>看到共集先警惕：增益小于 1，通常难满足幅值条件。</p></div>
<div class="quick"><div class="n">06 · 晶体</div><h3>先画高频交流通路</h3><p>先画高频交流通路，再判断晶体 / LC 选频支路。</p></div>
</div></section>
<section class="section" id="knowledge"><div class="section-head"><h2>知识点详解</h2></div><div class="knowledge-list">
<details class="knowledge-item"><summary>01｜正弦波振荡器的四个环节</summary><div class="knowledge-body"><p class="knowledge-lead">振荡器可以拆成四部分：放大电路、正反馈网络、选频网络、非线性稳幅环节。</p><p>所以判断“能不能振荡”不能只看有没有正反馈。正反馈只是必要环节之一，还要同时看增益和选频。</p></div></details>
<details class="knowledge-item"><summary>02｜起振条件与平衡条件</summary><div class="knowledge-body"><p class="knowledge-lead">起振和平衡不能混成一件事：起振时需要环路增益“够大”，稳定后再回到幅值与相位平衡。</p><p>源笔记把这部分压成“<span style="font-family:'Times New Roman',serif">AF≥1</span>”的记忆式。这里保留课程笔记的考试口径，不另外改写成另一套教材符号体系。</p></div></details>
<details class="knowledge-item"><summary>03｜RC 文氏桥</summary><div class="knowledge-body"><p class="knowledge-lead">文氏电桥是 RC 振荡器的核心题型，笔记给出的常见应用频段是 20 Hz–200 kHz。</p><p>考试常见三种变化：补连线、判断能否振荡、根据 R/C 调节范围求 f<sub>0</sub>范围。</p></div></details>
<details class="knowledge-item"><summary>04｜LC 变压器耦合式</summary><div class="knowledge-body"><p class="knowledge-lead">这类题重点看同名端和反馈极性。一个很实用的筛选点是：共集电路电压增益接近 1 且小于 1，难以满足幅值条件，因此看到共集结构要优先检查能否起振。</p></div></details>
<details class="knowledge-item"><summary>05｜三点式：射同基反</summary><div class="knowledge-body"><p class="knowledge-lead">电感三点式、电容三点式都可以用“射同基反”辅助判断：射极两侧接同性质电抗，基极对应相反性质电抗。</p><p>快速识别时还可以先看：电容较多的结构，常对应电容反馈式。这个提示适合快速认图，但最后仍要回到实际连接关系。</p></div></details>
<details class="knowledge-item"><summary>06｜LC 谐振网络的频率性质</summary><div class="knowledge-body"><p class="knowledge-lead">谐振时网络呈纯阻性。LC 并联：高于谐振频率呈容性、低于谐振频率呈感性；LC 串联则相反。</p><p>这组结论常常不是单独问，而是用来限制“可能的振荡频率范围”。</p></div></details>
<details class="knowledge-item"><summary>07｜石英晶体</summary><div class="knowledge-body"><p class="knowledge-lead">晶体的两种常用状态要分开：串联谐振附近近似短路；并联谐振附近可等效成感性。</p><p>做晶体题先画交流通路，再判断目标频率附近晶体等效成什么。不要只看原图位置硬猜它在电路里起什么作用。</p></div></details>
<details class="knowledge-item"><summary>08｜大题压缩成“三问”</summary><div class="knowledge-body"><p class="knowledge-lead">整章大题先压成三问：有没有放大？有没有正反馈？有没有选频网络？</p><p>频段上可以先这样联想：RC 常用于较低频，LC 用于较高频，石英晶体用于固定或很窄的频率选择。先用这三问筛，再进入公式。</p></div></details>
<details class="knowledge-item"><summary>09｜别和“负反馈自激”混成一件事</summary><div class="knowledge-body"><p class="knowledge-lead">反馈章节里的自激，是负反馈放大器在某些频段失去稳定性后“自己振起来”；本章正弦波振荡器则是有意引入正反馈，并用选频网络确定振荡频率。</p><p>两者都可能出现“没有外加输入仍有交流输出”，但设计目的和分析入口不同。选择填空很适合拿这两个概念做干扰项。</p></div></details>
</div></section>
<section class="section" id="papers"><div class="section-head"><h2>历年真题</h2><p>四套卷中有 3 套出现独立振荡大题；2019–2020 这套没有独立振荡大题。</p></div><div class="coverage-card"><span class="coverage-kicker">Exam Coverage</span>四套卷里有 <strong>3 年出现独立振荡题</strong>。最常见入口就是：文氏桥连线 / 起振、LC 三点式“射同基反”、以及给图判断能否振荡；石英晶体更偏识别和电抗性质。</div>
<article class="exam"><div class="exam-head"><div class="exam-title"><h3>2018–2019 A卷 · 第8题</h3><div class="tagrow"><span class="tag">LC</span><span class="tag">三点式</span><span class="tag">频率范围</span><span class="tag">振荡判断</span></div></div><div class="score">10 分 · LC 综合</div></div><div class="exam-body"><div class="original"><img alt="2018-2019 A卷 第8题" decoding="async" loading="lazy" src="data:image/webp;base64,"/></div><div class="solution"><div class="label">FIRST LOOK</div><h4>先判电抗性质，再用“射同基反”</h4><div class="exam-flow"><span class="flow-label">判断</span><p>三点式题先看各支路在候选频率下呈感性还是容性，再检查是否满足相位条件。</p></div><div class="sop"><span class="flow-label">步骤</span><div>认三点式 → 判支路电抗 → 用“射同基反” → 限定频率范围 → 查能否振荡</div></div><div class="exam-tip"><span class="flow-label">易错</span><div>图(b)原卷未保留明确手写结论，网页只保留可由现有笔记支持的部分。</div></div><div class="score-tip"><span class="flow-label">得分提醒</span>先判断各支路在目标频率附近呈感性还是容性，再用“射同基反”判相位；频率范围放到最后。</div><details><summary>关键结果</summary><div class="inner"><p>按本章现有笔记的总结，图(a)可归到电感反馈式三点式 LC 振荡思路；为了让两个并联 LC 支路都呈感性，振荡频率应满足 <span style="font-family:'Times New Roman',serif">f<sub>0</sub> &lt; min(f<sub>01</sub>, f<sub>02</sub>)</span>。图(b)在现有卷面中没有保留明确手写结论，因此这里不把推断伪装成原答案。</p></div></details></div></div></article>
<div class="absence">2019–2020 B 卷：当前四套真题中未见独立的正弦波振荡大题，因此这里不强行补一张“伪真题”。</div>
<article class="exam"><div class="exam-head"><div class="exam-title"><h3>2020–2021 A卷 · 第8题</h3><div class="tagrow"><span class="tag">RC</span><span class="tag">文氏桥</span><span class="tag">起振条件</span><span class="tag">调频</span></div></div><div class="score">8 分 · 母题</div></div><div class="exam-body"><div class="original"><img alt="2020-2021 A卷 第8题" decoding="async" loading="lazy" src="data:image/webp;base64,"/></div><div class="solution"><div class="label">FIRST LOOK</div><h4>文氏桥：先抓 F=1/3</h4><div class="exam-flow"><span class="flow-label">判断</span><p>谐振时先用反馈系数 1/3，再让放大器增益满足起振条件；频率范围由 R、C 调节范围决定。</p></div><div class="sop"><span class="flow-label">步骤</span><div>F=1/3 → 写 A → 起振条件 → 求 R_p,min → f_0=1/(2πRC)</div></div><div class="exam-tip"><span class="flow-label">易错</span><div>“能否起振”看不等式，“稳定振荡”才对应平衡条件。</div></div><div class="score-tip"><span class="flow-label">得分提醒</span>题目问“能否起振”时看起振条件，不要把平衡条件和起振条件混成一个等号。</div><details><summary>关键结果</summary><div class="inner"><p>卷面结果：<span style="font-family:'Times New Roman',serif">R<sub>p,min</sub>≈5.3 kΩ</span>；当可变电阻使等效 R 约在 10–110 kΩ 之间变化、<span style="font-family:'Times New Roman',serif">C=0.01 μF</span> 时，<span style="font-family:'Times New Roman',serif">f<sub>0</sub>≈145 Hz ～ 1.59 kHz</span>。</p></div></details></div></div></article>
<article class="exam"><div class="exam-head"><div class="exam-title"><h3>2021–2022 B卷 · 第8题</h3><div class="tagrow"><span class="tag">高频交流通路</span><span class="tag">LC</span><span class="tag">电容三点式</span><span class="tag">电路功能</span></div></div><div class="score">7 分 · 识图题</div></div><div class="exam-body"><div class="original"><img alt="2021-2022 B卷 第8题" decoding="async" loading="lazy" src="data:image/webp;base64,"/></div><div class="solution"><div class="label">FIRST LOOK</div><h4>高频先短路大电容，再重画</h4><div class="exam-flow"><span class="flow-label">判断</span><p>把大电容按交流短路处理后，原图会化成熟悉的三点式结构，再用“射同基反”判断。</p></div><div class="sop"><span class="flow-label">步骤</span><div>大电容短路 → 重画交流通路 → 认三点式 → 用“射同基反” → 判功能</div></div><div class="exam-tip"><span class="flow-label">易错</span><div>原卷未保留手写答案，所以结论继续明确标成“按本章框架整理”。</div></div><div class="score-tip"><span class="flow-label">得分提醒</span>先把高频交流通路重画出来：耦合 / 旁路大电容按短路处理，选频网络元件不要误短。</div><details><summary>关键结果</summary><div class="inner"><p>依据卷面电路和本章“三点式 / 射同基反”的分析框架整理，高频交流通路可识别为电容反馈式三点 LC 选频结构，也就是电容三点式正弦波振荡器。原卷此处未保留手写解答，因此这条在网页中标作“按本章框架整理”的结论。</p></div></details></div></div></article>
</section>
<section class="section" id="check"><div class="section-head"><h2>考前清单</h2><p>振荡题做完后，用 20 秒扫一遍。</p></div><div class="checklist">
<div class="check"><div class="check-no">01</div><div class="check-text"><input aria-label="完成此项" class="check-box" type="checkbox"/><span>有没有先确认放大、正反馈、选频三个环节？</span></div></div>
<div class="check"><div class="check-no">02</div><div class="check-text"><input aria-label="完成此项" class="check-box" type="checkbox"/><span>起振和稳态平衡条件有没有混？</span></div></div>
<div class="check"><div class="check-no">03</div><div class="check-text"><input aria-label="完成此项" class="check-box" type="checkbox"/><span>文氏桥有没有先想到 F=1/3？</span></div></div>
<div class="check"><div class="check-no">04</div><div class="check-text"><input aria-label="完成此项" class="check-box" type="checkbox"/><span>调频题有没有先找 R、C 的可变范围？</span></div></div>
<div class="check"><div class="check-no">05</div><div class="check-text"><input aria-label="完成此项" class="check-box" type="checkbox"/><span>LC 三点式有没有用“射同基反”检查相位？</span></div></div>
<div class="check"><div class="check-no">06</div><div class="check-text"><input aria-label="完成此项" class="check-box" type="checkbox"/><span>并联 LC / 串联 LC 的感容性有没有记反？</span></div></div>
<div class="check"><div class="check-no">07</div><div class="check-text"><input aria-label="完成此项" class="check-box" type="checkbox"/><span>画高频交流通路时，耦合/旁路电容处理对了吗？</span></div></div>
<div class="check"><div class="check-no">08</div><div class="check-text"><input aria-label="完成此项" class="check-box" type="checkbox"/><span>共集放大倍数小于 1 这个限制记住了吗？</span></div></div>
</div></section>
<nav aria-label="章节切换" class="chapter-pager"><a href="#power"><span class="dir">上一章</span><span class="name">← 功率放大</span></a><a class="next" href="#modulation"><span class="dir">下一章</span><span class="name">调制 →</span></a></nav>
</main></template>
<template id="tpl-modulation"><main class="single-main">
<section class="hero"><h1>MODULATION</h1><div class="hero-lead">先认 AM / FM，再从表达式里拆出载频、调制频率、调制指数；最后做频谱、带宽和功率</div><div class="priority-strip" aria-label="本章复习优先级"><span class="priority-pill"><b>SELECT</b>调制目的</span><span class="priority-pill hot"><b>COMMON</b>AM 频谱 / 带宽</span><span class="priority-pill hot"><b>COMMON</b>AM 功率</span></div></section>
<section class="grid" id="quick">
<div class="card"><h2 class="card-title">通用解题链</h2><div class="sop-chain">
<div class="sop-step"><span class="idx">01</span><strong>认 AM / FM</strong></div><div class="sop-step"><span class="idx">02</span><strong>拆载波参数</strong></div><div class="sop-step"><span class="idx">03</span><strong>拆调制参数</strong></div><div class="sop-step"><span class="idx">04</span><strong>求调制指数</strong></div><div class="sop-step"><span class="idx">05</span><strong>画频谱 / 判频偏</strong></div><div class="sop-step"><span class="idx">06</span><strong>求带宽 BW</strong></div><div class="sop-step"><span class="idx">07</span><strong>算边频 / 总功率</strong></div><div class="sop-step"><span class="idx">08</span><strong>检查单位</strong></div>
</div></div>
<div class="card"><div class="formula-kicker">Core Formula</div><div class="formula">AM：u = U<sub>cm</sub>(1+m<sub>a</sub>cosΩt)cosω<sub>c</sub>t</div><div class="formula">AM：BW = 2f<sub>m</sub>，P = P<sub>c</sub>(1+m<sub>a</sub><sup>2</sup>/2)</div><div class="formula">FM（真题补充）：Δf = m<sub>f</sub>f<sub>m</sub>，BW ≈ 2(Δf+f<sub>m</sub>)</div><div class="note">正文笔记的重心是 AM：调制目的、标准调幅表达式、频谱、调幅指数、带宽和功率。FM 则主要来自历年真题，因此做题第一步必须先认表达式类型，避免把 AM 的 <span style="font-family:'Times New Roman',serif">m_a</span> 和 FM 的 <span style="font-family:'Times New Roman',serif">m_f</span> 混用。</div></div>
</section>
<section class="section"><div class="section-head"><h2>速通</h2></div><div class="quick-grid">
<div class="quick"><div class="n">01 · 调制目的</div><h3>先记最核心：把低频信号搬到高频载波上</h3><p>目的速记：降低天线长度、频分复用、增强抗噪。</p></div>
<div class="quick"><div class="n">02 · 标准调幅</div><h3>包络幅度跟着调制信号变</h3><p>AM：0&lt;m≤1 正常；m&gt;1 过调幅。</p></div>
<div class="quick"><div class="n">03 · AM 频谱</div><h3>三条线：下边频、载频、上边频</h3><p>三条谱线：f<sub>c</sub>−f<sub>m</sub>、f<sub>c</sub>、f<sub>c</sub>+f<sub>m</sub>；BW=2f<sub>m</sub>。</p></div>
<div class="quick"><div class="n">04 · AM 功率</div><h3>载波功率 + 两个边频功率</h3><p>功率题：先算两边频，再与载波功率相加。</p></div>
<div class="quick"><div class="n">05 · FM</div><h3>相位括号里的系数就是调频指数入口</h3><p>FM 真题：先读 f<sub>m</sub>、m<sub>f</sub>，再算 Δf 和有效带宽。</p></div>
<div class="quick"><div class="n">06 · 最易错</div><h3>角频率和普通频率别混</h3><p>先把角频率写成 2πf；别在单位换算上丢分。</p></div>
</div></section>
<section class="section" id="knowledge"><div class="section-head"><h2>知识点详解</h2></div><div class="knowledge-list">
<details class="knowledge-item"><summary>01｜为什么要调制</summary><div class="knowledge-body"><p class="knowledge-lead">调制的三个核心目的按笔记直接记：降低天线长度、实现频分复用、增强抗噪声能力。</p><p>这里更像直接送分的概念题，别只记“搬移频谱”而漏掉笔记真正强调的三项目的。</p></div></details>
<details class="knowledge-item"><summary>02｜标准调幅 SAM</summary><div class="knowledge-body"><p class="knowledge-lead">标准调幅让载波幅度随调制信号变化。可以直接用上下包络理解调制度：上包络幅值为 (1+m<sub>a</sub>)U<sub>cm</sub>，下包络幅值为 (1−m<sub>a</sub>)U<sub>cm</sub>。</p><p>看到时域表达式时，先把载波项和包络项拆开，再读载频、调制频率和调制度。</p></div></details>
<details class="knowledge-item"><summary>03｜调幅指数与过调幅</summary><div class="knowledge-body"><p class="knowledge-lead">0&lt;m<sub>a</sub>≤1 时，包络能够正确反映调制信号；m<sub>a</sub>&gt;1 时进入过调幅，包络失真；m<sub>a</sub>=1 对应 100% 调幅。</p><p>这组结论既能直接考概念，也会藏在波形判断里。</p></div></details>
<details class="knowledge-item"><summary>04｜AM 频谱与带宽</summary><div class="knowledge-body"><p class="knowledge-lead">标准 AM 频谱由载频、上边频、下边频三部分组成。真正包含调制信息的是上下边频。</p><p>单音调制时，带宽就是上下两个边频之间的跨度。画频谱时先定载频，再向两侧平移调制频率。</p></div></details>
<details class="knowledge-item"><summary>05｜AM 功率</summary><div class="knowledge-body"><p class="knowledge-lead">边频功率、总功率、效率都是常考点。功率题要分清载波功率、两个边频功率和总功率，不要把“总功率增加”理解成信息功率也同样增加。</p><p>标准调幅的最大调制效率较低，笔记总结记为约 0.33。</p></div></details>
<details class="knowledge-item"><summary>06｜FM：主要从真题学</summary><div class="knowledge-body"><p class="knowledge-lead">这一章要明确分成两层：AM 是正文笔记的系统内容；FM 主要来自历年真题里的计算题。</p><div class="knowledge-note">正文笔记没有完整展开 FM 带宽公式推导。真题解析中使用的 BW≈2(Δf+f<sub>m</sub>) 属于真题计算补充，与课程笔记正文明确区分。</div></div></details>
<details class="knowledge-item"><summary>07｜单位检查</summary><div class="knowledge-body"><p class="knowledge-lead">AM 带宽处最容易丢分的一点，就是把角频率 Ω 和普通频率 f 混在一起。</p><p>最后统一检查 rad/s、Hz、kHz、MHz。调制题很多错误并不是思路错，而是单位没有统一。</p></div></details>
</div></section>
<section class="section" id="papers"><div class="section-head"><h2>历年真题</h2><p>四套卷里调制连续出现：两道 AM、两道 FM，基本就是“读表达式 + 带宽 + 功率/频偏”。</p></div><div class="coverage-card"><span class="coverage-kicker">Exam Coverage</span>四套卷里 <strong>4/4 都考了调制</strong>。正文笔记的主线是标准 AM：调幅指数、频谱、带宽、功率；FM 的调频指数、频偏和有效带宽主要来自历年真题补充。</div>
<article class="exam"><div class="exam-head"><div class="exam-title"><h3>2018–2019 A卷 · 第5题</h3><div class="tagrow"><span class="tag">AM</span><span class="tag">频谱</span><span class="tag">调幅指数</span><span class="tag">带宽</span></div></div><div class="score">6 分 · AM 母题</div></div><div class="exam-body"><div class="original"><img alt="2018-2019 A卷 第5题" decoding="async" loading="lazy" src="data:image/webp;base64,"/></div><div class="solution"><div class="label">FIRST LOOK</div><h4>看到“包络 × 载波”，先认标准 AM</h4><div class="exam-flow"><span class="flow-label">判断</span><p>从载波项读 f_c，从调制项读 f_m，从包络系数读 m，再展开载波和两条边频。</p></div><div class="sop"><span class="flow-label">步骤</span><div>认 AM → 读 f_c、f_m、m → 写三条谱线 → 求 BW=2f_m</div></div><div class="exam-tip"><span class="flow-label">易错</span><div>先把角频率换成普通频率，别把 π×10³ 直接当 1 kHz。</div></div><div class="score-tip"><span class="flow-label">得分提醒</span>先把 f<sub>c</sub>、f<sub>m</sub>、m<sub>a</sub> 从表达式里逐个标出来，再画三根谱线，频率和幅度不要混。</div><details><summary>关键结果</summary><div class="inner"><p>这是标准 AM；<span style="font-family:'Times New Roman',serif">f<sub>c</sub>=1 MHz，f<sub>m</sub>=500 Hz，m=0.8</span>。</p><p>频谱：载频在 <span style="font-family:'Times New Roman',serif">1 MHz</span>，上下边频在 <span style="font-family:'Times New Roman',serif">999.5 kHz</span> 与 <span style="font-family:'Times New Roman',serif">1000.5 kHz</span>；按题式展开，两条边频幅度各为 <span style="font-family:'Times New Roman',serif">4 V</span>，载波幅度 <span style="font-family:'Times New Roman',serif">10 V</span>。</p><p><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman',serif">BW=1 kHz</span>。</p></div></details></div></div></article>
<article class="exam"><div class="exam-head"><div class="exam-title"><h3>2019–2020 B卷 · 第10题</h3><div class="tagrow"><span class="tag">FM</span><span class="tag">调频指数</span><span class="tag">频偏</span><span class="tag">有效带宽</span></div></div><div class="score">FM 带宽题</div></div><div class="exam-body"><div class="original"><img alt="2019-2020 B卷 第10题" decoding="async" loading="lazy" src="data:image/webp;base64,"/></div><div class="solution"><div class="label">FIRST LOOK</div><h4>先从相位项读 f_m 和 m_f</h4><div class="exam-flow"><span class="flow-label">判断</span><p>相位系数给出调频指数，调制角频率给出 f_m；读出两个量后再求频偏和有效带宽。</p></div><div class="sop"><span class="flow-label">步骤</span><div>读 f_m → 读 m_f → 求 Δf → 求有效 BW → 条件变化后重算</div></div><div class="exam-tip"><span class="flow-label">易错</span><div>题目说“调制振幅不变”时，先判断频偏是否随频率变化。</div></div><div class="score-tip"><span class="flow-label">得分提醒</span>这道 FM 的带宽关系属于真题补充内容；先读 f<sub>m</sub> 和 m<sub>f</sub>，再求频偏，最后算带宽。</div><details><summary>关键结果</summary><div class="inner"><p>原题：<span style="font-family:'Times New Roman',serif">f<sub>m</sub>=1 kHz，m<sub>f</sub>=10，Δf=10 kHz</span>，有效带宽约 <span style="font-family:'Times New Roman',serif">BW=22 kHz</span>。</p><p>若调制信号频率增大一倍而振幅不变，则频偏保持 <span style="font-family:'Times New Roman',serif">10 kHz</span>，新的 <span style="font-family:'Times New Roman',serif">f<sub>m</sub>=2 kHz</span>，所以有效带宽约 <span style="font-family:'Times New Roman',serif">24 kHz</span>。</p></div></details></div></div></article>
<article class="exam"><div class="exam-head"><div class="exam-title"><h3>2020–2021 A卷 · 第4题</h3><div class="tagrow"><span class="tag">AM</span><span class="tag">载波功率</span><span class="tag">总功率</span><span class="tag">带宽</span></div></div><div class="score">6 分 · 功率题</div></div><div class="exam-body"><div class="original"><img alt="2020-2021 A卷 第4题" decoding="async" loading="lazy" src="data:image/webp;base64,"/></div><div class="solution"><div class="label">FIRST LOOK</div><h4>AM 功率题：带宽和功率分开算</h4><div class="exam-flow"><span class="flow-label">判断</span><p>带宽只看最高调制频率；总功率则由载波功率与两条边频功率相加。</p></div><div class="sop"><span class="flow-label">步骤</span><div>BW=2f_m → 求总边频功率 → P总=P_c+P边频总</div></div><div class="exam-tip"><span class="flow-label">易错</span><div>载波功率和总功率不是同一个量。</div></div><div class="score-tip"><span class="flow-label">得分提醒</span>AM 功率题把“载波功率、两边频总功率、总功率”分开写，避免把一个边频功率当成两边频总和。</div><details><summary>关键结果</summary><div class="inner"><p><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman',serif">BW=40 Hz</span>。</p><p>总边频功率 <span style="font-family:'Times New Roman',serif">=12.5 kW</span>，因此总功率 <span style="font-family:'Times New Roman',serif">P=112.5 kW</span>；两条边频各为 <span style="font-family:'Times New Roman',serif">6.25 kW</span>。</p></div></details></div></div></article>
<article class="exam"><div class="exam-head"><div class="exam-title"><h3>2021–2022 B卷 · 第3题</h3><div class="tagrow"><span class="tag">FM</span><span class="tag">调制频率</span><span class="tag">载频</span><span class="tag">调频指数</span><span class="tag">有效带宽</span></div></div><div class="score">8 分 · FM 综合</div></div><div class="exam-body"><div class="original"><img alt="2021-2022 B卷 第3题" decoding="async" loading="lazy" src="data:image/webp;base64,"/></div><div class="solution"><div class="label">FIRST LOOK</div><h4>先把表达式里的已知量逐个读出来</h4><div class="exam-flow"><span class="flow-label">判断</span><p>音频项给 F_Ω，载波项给 f_c，相位系数给 m_f；读完后再求频偏与带宽。</p></div><div class="sop"><span class="flow-label">步骤</span><div>读 F_Ω → 读 f_c → 读 m_f → 求 Δf → 求有效 BW</div></div><div class="exam-tip"><span class="flow-label">易错</span><div>先统一 Hz / kHz / MHz，再代公式。</div></div><div class="score-tip"><span class="flow-label">得分提醒</span>先从相位项读出 m<sub>f</sub> 和 f<sub>m</sub>；这两个量读对了，后面的频偏和带宽就是公式链。</div><details><summary>关键结果</summary><div class="inner"><p><span style="font-family:'Times New Roman',serif">F<sub>Ω</sub>=10 kHz</span>，<span style="font-family:'Times New Roman',serif">f<sub>c</sub>=100 MHz</span>，<span style="font-family:'Times New Roman',serif">m<sub>f</sub>=6</span>。</p><p>频偏 <span style="font-family:'Times New Roman',serif">Δf=60 kHz</span>，有效频带宽度约 <span style="font-family:'Times New Roman',serif">BW=140 kHz</span>。</p></div></details></div></div></article>
</section>
<section class="section" id="check"><div class="section-head"><h2>考前清单</h2><p>调制题做完后，用 20 秒扫一遍。</p></div><div class="checklist">
<div class="check"><div class="check-no">01</div><div class="check-text"><input aria-label="完成此项" class="check-box" type="checkbox"/><span>先认清是 AM 还是 FM 了吗？</span></div></div>
<div class="check"><div class="check-no">02</div><div class="check-text"><input aria-label="完成此项" class="check-box" type="checkbox"/><span>角频率 ω 有没有正确换成普通频率 f？</span></div></div>
<div class="check"><div class="check-no">03</div><div class="check-text"><input aria-label="完成此项" class="check-box" type="checkbox"/><span>AM 的 m 和 FM 的 m<sub>f</sub> 有没有混？</span></div></div>
<div class="check"><div class="check-no">04</div><div class="check-text"><input aria-label="完成此项" class="check-box" type="checkbox"/><span>AM 频谱的上下边频位置写对了吗？</span></div></div>
<div class="check"><div class="check-no">05</div><div class="check-text"><input aria-label="完成此项" class="check-box" type="checkbox"/><span>AM 带宽是不是用了 2f<sub>m</sub>？</span></div></div>
<div class="check"><div class="check-no">06</div><div class="check-text"><input aria-label="完成此项" class="check-box" type="checkbox"/><span>AM 总功率有没有把两个边频都算进去？</span></div></div>
<div class="check"><div class="check-no">07</div><div class="check-text"><input aria-label="完成此项" class="check-box" type="checkbox"/><span>FM 有没有先由 m<sub>f</sub>f<sub>m</sub> 求频偏？</span></div></div>
<div class="check"><div class="check-no">08</div><div class="check-text"><input aria-label="完成此项" class="check-box" type="checkbox"/><span>Hz / kHz / MHz 单位有没有统一？</span></div></div>
</div></section>
<nav aria-label="章节切换" class="chapter-pager"><a href="#oscillator"><span class="dir">上一章</span><span class="name">← 正弦波振荡</span></a><a class="next" href="#diode"><span class="dir">下一章</span><span class="name">二极管与稳压管 →</span></a></nav>
</main></template>

<script>
(() => {
  const META = {"diode":{code:"DIODE",name:"二极管与稳压管",i:0},"fet":{code:"FET",name:"场效应管",i:1},"bjt":{code:"BJT",name:"双极型晶体管",i:2},"frequency":{code:"FREQ",name:"频率响应",i:3},"diff":{code:"DIFF",name:"差动放大",i:4},"feedback":{code:"FEEDBACK",name:"反馈",i:5},"opamp":{code:"OP AMP",name:"运放与比较器",i:6},"power":{code:"POWER AMP",name:"功率放大",i:7},"oscillator":{code:"OSC",name:"正弦波振荡",i:8},"modulation":{code:"MOD",name:"调制",i:9}};
  const ORDER = ["diode","fet","bjt","frequency","diff","feedback","opamp","power","oscillator","modulation"];
  const app = document.getElementById('app');
  const nav = document.getElementById('siteNav');
  const lightbox = document.getElementById('globalLightbox');
  const lightboxImg = lightbox.querySelector('img');
  let observer = null;

  function parseRoute(){
    let raw = location.hash.replace(/^#/, '');
    if(!raw || raw === 'home') return {page:'home', section:null};
    const [page, section] = raw.split('/');
    if(!META[page]) return {page:'home', section:null};
    return {page, section:section || null};
  }

  function setNav(page, activeSection){
    if(page === 'home'){
      nav.innerHTML = '<a class="is-active" href="#home">章节总览</a>';
      return;
    }
    const links = [
      ['home','章节'],['quick','速通'],['knowledge','知识点'],['papers','真题'],['check','考前清单']
    ];
    nav.innerHTML = links.map(([sec,label]) => {
      const href = sec === 'home' ? '#home' : `#${page}/${sec}`;
      const active = (activeSection ? activeSection === sec : sec === 'quick') ? ' is-active' : '';
      return `<a class="${active.trim()}" data-sec="${sec}" href="${href}">${label}</a>`;
    }).join('');
  }

  function render(){
    if(observer){ observer.disconnect(); observer = null; }
    const {page, section} = parseRoute();
    const template = document.getElementById(`tpl-${page}`);
    app.replaceChildren(template.content.cloneNode(true));
    app.firstElementChild?.classList.add('route-fade');
    setNav(page, section);
    document.title = page === 'home' ? 'Analog Survival Guide｜Clover 模电期末生存指南' : `${META[page].code}｜Analog Survival Guide`;
    initPage(page);
    requestAnimationFrame(() => {
      if(section){
        const target = app.querySelector(`#${CSS.escape(section)}`);
        if(target) target.scrollIntoView({block:'start'});
      } else {
        window.scrollTo({top:0, behavior:'instant'});
      }
    });
  }

  function initPage(page){
    if(page === 'home') return;

    // Replace pager semantics with hash routing and correct labels when needed.
    app.querySelectorAll('.chapter-pager a').forEach(a => {
      const hash = a.getAttribute('href');
      if(hash && hash.startsWith('#')) a.addEventListener('click', () => {});
    });

    // Active section tracking.
    const sectionLinks = [...nav.querySelectorAll('a[data-sec]:not([data-sec="home"])')];
    const sections = sectionLinks.map(a => app.querySelector('#'+a.dataset.sec)).filter(Boolean);
    if('IntersectionObserver' in window && sections.length){
      observer = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
        const visible = entries.filter(e => e.isIntersecting).sort((a,b)=>b.intersectionRatio-a.intersectionRatio)[0];
        if(!visible) return;
        sectionLinks.forEach(a => a.classList.toggle('is-active', a.dataset.sec === visible.target.id));
      }, {rootMargin:'-20% 0px -65% 0px', threshold:[0,.1,.4]});
      sections.forEach(s => observer.observe(s));
    }

    // Checklist state per chapter.
    const boxes = [...app.querySelectorAll('.check-box')];
    const key = 'asg-single-check-'+page;
    let saved = {}; try{saved = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key)||'{}')}catch(e){}
    boxes.forEach((b,i) => {
      b.checked = !!saved[i];
      b.addEventListener('change', () => {saved[i]=b.checked; try{localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(saved))}catch(e){}});
    });
    app.querySelectorAll('.check').forEach(row => row.addEventListener('click', e => {
      if(e.target.matches('input')) return;
      const box = row.querySelector('.check-box');
      if(box){ box.checked = !box.checked; box.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); }
    }));

    // Knowledge accordion.
    const knowledgeItems = [...app.querySelectorAll('details.knowledge-item')];
    knowledgeItems.forEach(item => item.addEventListener('toggle', () => {
      if(!item.open) return;
      knowledgeItems.forEach(other => { if(other !== item) other.open = false; });
    }));

    // Image lightbox.
    app.querySelectorAll('.original img').forEach(src => src.addEventListener('click', () => {
      lightboxImg.src = src.src;
      lightboxImg.alt = src.alt || '原题大图';
      lightbox.classList.add('open');
      lightbox.setAttribute('aria-hidden','false');
    }));
  }

  lightbox.addEventListener('click', () => {
    lightbox.classList.remove('open'); lightbox.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true'); lightboxImg.src='';
  });
  document.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if(e.key === 'Escape' && lightbox.classList.contains('open')) lightbox.click(); });
  window.addEventListener('hashchange', render);
  render();
})();
</script>

</body>
</html>
